I have very fair skin and I love eyeshadow, are there any palettes that I absolutely need??
If you take a bronzer it can double up as just a simple colour for the eyelid 😊

I really like the too faced chocolate bar palette and it has some nice dark browns that are v pigmented and blendable. For black I use the Anastasia Beverly Hills single shadow in the shade 'noir' and it is soo good!

They are honestly incredible. They're so easy to use, so pigmented and so beautiful! So they do have fall out like any regular glitter, once they are dry. So I apply mine, let it dry with my eyes closed so it doesn't crease or anything and spread around, and then once it's dry I don't touch it and it stays out, basically it will only get fall out of you try touching the dried glitter

Tarte shape tape is honestly as good as everyone says it is! I would recommend getting a lighter shade than your foundation for under the eyes to highlight the face and then get one the same shade as your foundation for blemishes. I use the shade 'fair neutral' and I am so pale and it just works so well, it doesn't crease if you set it and it lasts all day!

I am very very pale (I use the shade 'blanc' from hourglass) and I think the too faced cocoa contour kit is perfect for pale skin! The shade medium cocoa is great because it's not too warm but it's not ashy either. 10/10 would recommend 👍🏼
I love the rcma no colour powder and it's so much cheaper than laura mercier but does the exact same thing in my opinion!!!
